findings.description: reschedule acquires the lock, but the early `return False` (unknown job or non-pending status) leaves it held. The lock is a non-reentrant threading.Lock, so every later call to _acquire blocks for the timeout and then raises SchedulerBusy, which wedges the whole scheduler. Any exception raised between acquire and release has the same effect, because there is no try/finally.
findings.suggestion: Wrap the body in try/finally, as the other methods do, and release the lock in the finally block. Remove the explicit release before `return True`.
findings.title: Lock not released on early return in reschedule
